entries.title: Isaiah 21:1
segments: ¶The word about the waste land. As storm-winds in the South go rushing through, it comes from the waste land, from the land greatly to be feared.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:2
segments: A vision of fear comes before my eyes; the worker of deceit goes on in his false way, and the waster goes on making waste. Up! Elam; to the attack! Media; I have put an end to her sorrow.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:3
segments: For this cause I am full of bitter grief; pains like the pains of a woman in childbirth have come on me: I am bent down with sorrow at what comes to my ears; I am shocked by what I see.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:4
segments: My mind is wandering, fear has overcome me: the evening of my desire has been turned into shaking for me.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:5
segments: They make ready the table, they put down the covers, they take food and drink. Up! you captains; put oil on your breastplates.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:6
segments: For so has the Lord said to me, Go, let a watchman be placed; let him give word of what he sees:

entries.title: Isaiah 21:7
segments: And when he sees war-carriages, horsemen by twos, war-carriages with asses, war-carriages with camels, let him give special attention.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:8
segments: And the watchman gave a loud cry, O my lord, I am on the watchtower all day, and am placed in my watch every night:

entries.title: Isaiah 21:9
segments: See, here come war-carriages with men, horsemen by twos: and in answer he said, Babylon is made low, is made low, and all her images are broken on the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:10
segments: O my crushed ones, the grain of my floor! I have given you the word which came to me from the Lord of armies, the God of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:11
segments: ¶The word about Edom. A voice comes to me from Seir, Watchman, how far gone is the night? how far gone is the night?

entries.title: Isaiah 21:12
segments: The watchman says, The morning has come, but night is still to come: if you have questions to put, put them, and come back again.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:13
segments: ¶The word about Arabia. In the thick woods of Arabia will be your night's resting-place, O travelling bands of Dedanites!

entries.title: Isaiah 21:14
segments: Give water to him who is in need of water; give bread, O men of the land of Tema, to those in flight.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:15
segments: For they are in flight from the sharp sword, and the bent bow, and from the trouble of war.

entries.title: Isaiah 21:16
segments: For so has the Lord said to me, In a year, by the years of a servant working for payment, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end:

entries.title: Isaiah 21:17
segments: And the rest of the bowmen, the men of war of the children of Kedar, will be small in number: for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said it.
